edit.title: Edit router
edit.lanSubnetHint: Mikrotik local network (e.g. 192.168.88.0/24). If changed, paste the setup script into the router again.
edit.routerAdminNote: RouterOS control panel (REST API) login/password — optional, used to auto-detect IPs in the "Add terminal" form.

manage.timeUnchanged: Time is correct (drift {{count}} s) — not changed
manage.rebooting: Terminal is rebooting — unavailable for 1-2 minutes
manage.rebootConfirmMessage: The terminal will be down for 1-2 minutes and students won't be able to pass. Continue?
manage.deleteUserMessage: User {{id}} (with face) will be removed from the terminal. Platform data is not affected.
manage.facesHint: Students of this school with a photo and Face ID are uploaded to the terminal. Photos must be clear, frontal and at least 120px — unusable photos are listed as errors.
manage.eventsHint: Re-reads events from the device for a period without monitoring (e.g. the day before it was added) and records attendance. Duplicates are skipped automatically. Up to 7 days.
manage.unmatchedHint: The terminal thought it "recognized" a face, but that identifier didn't match any current student (e.g. an old face of a removed student may still be stored on the device).
manage.unsupported: This brand cannot be managed remotely yet (Hikvision only).

discovery.title: Discover devices
discovery.hint: The network behind the router is scanned over VPN. Found devices can be added in one click.
discovery.loginHint: Hikvision devices are found even without a login. With a login, each device gets a single attempt to read its model and type.
discovery.routerOffline: router OFFLINE — results may be incomplete

network.step1: Connect to the Mikrotik with WinBox and open New Terminal
network.step2: Click “Show setup script”, copy the whole script and paste it into the terminal (re-running is safe)
network.step3: Within a minute the router shows ONLINE here — then discover devices below
network.ros7Note: RouterOS 7 is required. On older versions the script stops by itself — upgrade via WinBox > System > Packages > Check For Updates.
network.transportHint: WireGuard is fast and light (UDP). If the school's internet blocks UDP or the router stays offline for more than 3 minutes, choose OpenVPN (TCP 443, passes through almost any network).
network.switchConfirmNote: The school stays disconnected until you paste the new script into the router. The script removes the old connection by itself.
network.switchError: Could not change the connection type

form.ipDiscoverEmpty: The router doesn't see any devices

device.sectionHint: With brand, IP and login set, camera status is monitored automatically and a live frame is shown (over the school router VPN).
device.rtspHint: Opens in VLC or an NVR from inside the school network (asks for login/password). Live video in the browser needs a media gateway.
device.notManagedHint: For a live frame set brand, IP and login in Settings → Cameras
